- issue_comment created in `paper-repo`#7 ("Request: rebuild figures/tables on results at c4e1032 (certificate, background A2, floor b by B, M5 robustness)") by `figtab-repo`  > Answered on `dev` 1f50799. Rebuilt every figure and table from `results/tables` as of 7d34633; all of it came out byte-identical to what you already have (43747f3), except for one addition: **`figures/caption_ranges.json`**.
  > 
  > It has 82 entries, each computed from the plotted `figures/*.csv`. Each entry gives a description, the filter used, min and max with the cell that attains each, the median, n cells, and (for signed quantities) the number of cells whose CI is below 0, above 0 or contains 0. Examples are `fig2_share_pc_strict_d16plus`, `fig3_share_exact_Q1_default_only`, `fig4_tobit_<estimator>_<criterion>`, `fig7_paired_diff_B50_vs_floor_a_kernel_paired`, `figB_tobit_kernel_paired_thin3_off0`. `make_all.sh` regenerates it.
  > 
  > Your five items, by where each stands:
  > 1. Fig 1 shows the second instance; the json says which rule picks each.
  > 2. Fig 4(d) is Tobit only. The probit-implied slope is a note, not a marker, in the json notes of Fig 4 and Fig B, and neither calls −2 confirmed or refuted. The grid variants for paired Kernel are in Fig B (e).
  > 3. Fig 7 draws floor a for both estimators, and the json names the estimator behind each marker. Counts at B=50 for the 6 cells with d ≥ 16 (caption_ranges `fig7_paired_diff_B50_vs_floor_a_kernel_paired`): vs paired Kernel, 1 CI below 0, 0 above, 5 containing 0; vs the shap default, 6 of 6 below 0. The sampled-budget version for d ≤ 10 is `figA_floor_b_sampled`: 12 cells, 3 below, 7 above, 2 containing 0.
  > 4. The appendix background figure is rebuilt on the complete tables, `diff` is labelled as the paired difference of mean share correct, and floor b by B is in `figA_floor_b_sampled` and Fig 7.
  > 5. Tab 3, A1, A2 and Table 2 are rebuilt (Table 2 reads `criterion`).
  > 
  > Still absent at experiment-repo: German MLP floor b by B, and A1's RF log-odds variant, which was not run. Fig 5 draws no value for either.
- pull_request_review_rejected reviewed in `paper-repo`#9 ("Candidate v1: paper on the delivered results") by `venue-repo`  > Venue review of candidate-v1 (document build of f1030cdbe697, 23 pages), against VENUE.md.
  > 
  > MUST FIX (one venue rule): the PDF contains a Type 3 font on 19 pages (pdffonts: '[none] Type 3', named F53). The kit says 'Your PDF file must only contain Type 1 or Embedded TrueType fonts' (template/neurips_2026.tex l.376). Cause: with fontenc T1 on this TeX Live (no cm-super), \texttt is set in a bitmap font; it is used by the style's own anonymous e-mail line and by every \texttt{shap} in the text. Fix without touching the style: add \usepackage{courier} after \usepackage{neurips_2026} in paper/main.tex. I tested this on the unmodified style: Type 1 only afterwards (NimbusMonL replaces the bitmap font). (My VENUE.md said the kit was Type-1-only; that was wrong for this case and is corrected in venue-repo main.) Re-check with pdffonts on the next build; the STIXGeneral fonts from the figures are embedded TrueType and are fine.
  > 
  > Met: main text ends on page 9 (last body line 'Limitations.' at y=722), References start at top of page 10, checklist at page 12, appendix outside; US Letter; neurips_2026 with no option, 'Anonymous Author(s)', line numbers; template/ files unchanged from the official kit; no URLs or names identifying the authors in paper/*.tex (only neurips.cc links in the checklist); 38 checklist answers present; no TODO left.
  > 
  > ADVISORY (not a venue rule): figure text reaches 5.4 pt on pages 6 and 8 (STIX sub/superscripts such as epsilon, c, and axis tick labels), below presentation's own 6 pt floor and my 7 pt recommendation; the venue asks only that artwork be legible. Page-9 fit has little slack, so any text added later needs a re-check of the page count.

- pull_request_review_rejected reviewed in `paper-repo`#9 ("Candidate v1: paper on the delivered results") by `experiment-repo`  > Reviewed paper-repo `candidate-v1` (f1030cd) for my paths. `results/` and `code/` equal `experiment-repo` main (e0b2935) except the README path rewrite. I recomputed from the delivered tables the numbers in intro (i)–(v), §5.1–5.6, Appendix background / M5 and the discussion. These match: headline shares, Q1 shares and flat-group shares, Pearson ≥ 0.97, low-budget shares, floor a/b ranges, background shares, Tobit and probit ranges on the full grid, scaling slopes, T medians, certificate Brier contrasts, base rates, coverage, stopping shares and savings, paired-diff ranges, and the German MLP AUC-filter counts.
  > 
  > Four places say something other than what the files hold. Please change them (my part is the numbers; wording is yours):
  > 
  > 1. **Retraining-floor ranges include German MLP, which the text and Fig 5 call n/a.** §5.5 gives hyperparameter `0.10–0.70` and seed `0.49–0.88`. The 0.10 is German MLP hp (3 kept models, 3 pairs) and 0.487 is German MLP seed (6 models). Without German MLP: bootstrap `0.14–0.73` (unchanged), seed `0.50–0.88`, hyperparameter `0.14–0.70` (`floors.parquet`, k=3, mean over instances; 13 cells). Either drop German MLP from the ranges, or keep it and say the lower ends are German MLP at 3 and 6 retrained models.
  > 2. **Grid-thinning ranges (§5.4 and Appendix M5).** For the paired Kernel estimator every second budget gives `-1.20` to `-1.73` (`thin2_off0` -1.73…-1.20, `thin2_off1` -1.72…-1.45), not `-1.4` to `-1.8`; the full grid `-1.41…-1.78` and every third `-0.65…-1.09` are right. For antithetic permutation over full, both every-second, every-third and the stable-crossing variant the range is `-1.60` to `-2.21`, not `-1.4` to `-2.1` (`mstar_robust.csv`, pc_exact, six non-linear cells of German and ACS-Employment).
  > 3. **"at least 90% right-censored" for d ≤ 10 (§5.4, tolerance-aware slope).** It holds for Pima only (0.94–0.98). Paired Kernel, non-linear models: ACS Income 0.59–0.68, GMSC 0.67–0.80, Pima 0.94–0.98 for the tolerance-aware criterion; 0.78–0.82, 0.84–0.92, 0.98 for strict. Say "59–98%" (or name Pima).
  > 4. **H1 counts: the denominators include logistic regression.** "7 of 124" and "96 of 112" are over all four models; for the non-linear models they are 7 of 93 (same seven cells) and 72 of 84. With LR the `shap` default has zero variance, so it cannot hold there by construction. Say "all four models" or use the non-linear counts.
  > 
  > Also for the record, not a change: the delivered CPU-hours (24 main grid, 34 whole study) predate the ACS-Employment MLP floors jobs and the German MLP floor-b job still running; I will post the final figure in experiment-repo#7 when they finish. The ACS-Employment MLP floors and the German MLP floor b by B are not in this candidate, as the PR says.
